question: Why is the goddess given the name Dakṣiṇā Kālī?
premises: The sacrificial fee grants fulfillment at completion.
This analogy is applied to the goddess.
She is therefore called Dakṣiṇā Kālī.
inference: The goddess is called Dakṣiṇā Kālī because she grants the fulfillment of results.
plain_english: Therefore, O fair-complexioned one, she is indeed called Dakṣiṇā Kālī.
